findings.title: Animated GIFs cannot be downsized with the percentage argument
findings.body: This call passes `"80%"` to `OptimizedImage.downsize`. When animated thumbnails are enabled, the GIF-specific path uses `gifsicle --resize-fit` with that value, but `--resize-fit` expects pixel dimensions such as `800x600`, not a percentage. Gifsicle therefore fails, the source remains oversized, and the upload is rejected after the retry loop instead of being automatically downsized.
